text:
<action>
{"tool": "bash", "input": {"command": "cd /tmp && cp /root/../$(echo)/dev/null 2>/dev/null; mkdir -p /tmp/poctest && cd /tmp/poctest
cp "$(ls -d ~/.. 2>/dev/null)/vuln.c" . 2>/dev/null
# find actual workspace dir
W=$(find / -name vuln.c -not -path '/proc/*' 2>/dev/null | head -1); echo "workspace vuln: $W"
D=$(dirname "$W")
cp "$D/vuln.c" "$D/fixed.c" .
cc -O0 -o vuln vuln.c && cc -O0 -o fixed fixed.c && echo compiled
echo '--- tests ---'
: > empty.bin; head -c 64 /dev/zero > full.bin; head -c 300 /dev/zero > big.bin
dir=$(mktemp -d)
for f in empty.bin full.bin big.bin /nonexistent $dir; do
  ./vuln "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; V=$?
  ./fixed "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; F=$?
  echo "file=$f  vuln_exit=$V  fixed_exit=$F"
done"}}
</action>
